gaps: No official dated record of caucus changes was found: the Assembly's LIMS gives only one party per member (as of dissolution), with no change dates and no OneBC or CentreBC. Every change date in this file comes from news reports (mostly CBC/CP/Black Press), apart from the Gasper resignation (BC Gov News) and the by-election call and cancellation (BC Gov News and Elections BC).

Standings at dissolution depend on whether the 2026-09-22 moves (Chapman to OneBC; seven CentreBC MLAs and Day back to the Conservatives) came before the dissolution proclamation. The exact dissolution time and proclamation or Order in Council were not found.
Exact OneBC registration date not confirmed from Elections BC (the registered-parties PDF gives no dates); stored as on or before 2025-06-12.

Joining dates for Milobar's unnamed party (Bird, Wat, Banman, Warbus) are bounded only by the 2026-09-14 CBC report; CentreBC joining is dated to the 2026-09-18 announcement, not to any party-registration record.
The Wayback Machine was offline (2026-09-25), so no dated snapshots of leg.bc.ca standings were available to check the order of events.
Vancouver-Strathcona: no source found on whether a by-election writ was considered before dissolution; only the absence of any by-election result is documented.

Rattée conflict: a Wikipedia member-table note says she resigned from caucus on 2026-08-27, but CBC on 2026-09-18 shows her still in caucus until the Clerk-notified removal. The Wikipedia claim was not adopted.

Brodie OneBC board removal: CBC gives Armstrong's post as Saturday 2025-12-13 and the Times Colonist gives the board announcement as Dec. 14. Her return as leader is bounded only as on or before 2025-12-22 (Wikipedia says 2025-12-21, not verified).
Coquitlam-Burke Mountain (Jodie Wickens) has no 2024 memberElection record in Assembly LIMS; the Statement of Votes is used.

Names differ between sources: Statement of Votes ballot names vs Assembly names (e.g. Reah vs Rohini Arora; A'aliya vs Á'a:líya Warbus; Debra Toporowski vs Qwulti'stunaat - Debra Toporowski; Tamara Davidson vs Laanas - Tamara Davidson). Both are kept; no canonical person IDs assigned.
Official Hansard or Votes and Proceedings entries (e.g. Speaker's statements on the vacancies or on OneBC recognition) were not consulted.
